$comment: Hand-maintained. What Revana's catalog cannot say about its own roster: which video models are the lipsync and avatar views (the catalog files both under kind "video"), and which routes unmodel deliberately does not address. Every entry carries a reason, a source and the date it was verified; scripts/codegen-revana.ts parses this file and fails on an id the catalog no longer lists.

bytedance-lipsync.reason: Re-voices an existing clip: tasks is ["video_to_video"], capabilities.audio_input is true, and the API answers a clip without a sound with "bytedance-lipsync needs input.audio_url: the voice or sound it animates to."

kling-avatar-pro.reason: Animates a still to a sound: tasks is ["image_to_video"], capabilities.audio_input is true, and input.audio_url is the driver ("A sound to drive the video (talking avatars, lip sync)").

kling-avatar-std.reason: Animates a still to a sound: tasks is ["image_to_video"], capabilities.audio_input is true, and input.audio_url is the driver ("A sound to drive the video (talking avatars, lip sync)").

omnihuman-1.5.reason: Animates a still to a sound: tasks is ["image_to_video"], capabilities.audio_input is true, and the API answers a picture without a sound with "omnihuman-1.5 needs input.audio_url: the voice or sound it animates to."

omnihuman-2.0.reason: Animates a still to a sound: "one picture and a voice track (4 seconds to 5 minutes) become a 720p video of that person speaking"; the API answers a picture without a sound with "omnihuman-2.0 needs input.audio_url: the voice or sound it animates to."

POST /v1/queue/fal-ai/{alias}.reason: Three fal endpoint paths (fal-ai/nano-banana-2, fal-ai/nano-banana-pro, fal-ai/veo3.1/fast) answer as aliases of nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro and veo-3.1-fast, so that a fal client needs only a base-URL rewrite. They are a migration aid, not a surface: "Only text-generation aliases listed above are provided; use canonical revana/{model_id} endpoints and catalog input fields for editing or other models." The canonical paths serve the same three models with their full input, and revana.imageQueue / revana.videoQueue address those.

POST /v1/videos.reason: Named once, in passing ("Existing /v1/generations and /v1/videos continue to work unchanged"), and documented nowhere: not in the OpenAPI document, the docs or llms-full.txt. A route with no published shape cannot be typed.
